request.prompt:
Goods: Rechargeable electric toothbrush with self-contained motor
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 85 Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles > 8509 Electro-mechanical domestic appliances; with self-contained electric motor, other than vacuum cleaners of heading 85.08.

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 850940: Electro-mechanical domestic appliances; food grinders and mixers, fruit or vegetable juice extractors, with self-contained electric motor
- 850980: Electro-mechanical domestic appliances; with self-contained electric motor, other than vacuum cleaners of heading 85.08, n.e.c. in heading no. 8509
- 850990: Electro-mechanical domestic appliances; parts for the appliances of heading no. 8509

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: An electric toothbrush with its own motor is not a food grinder, mixer or juice extractor (850940) and is a complete appliance rather than a part (850990), so it falls under the residual 'other appliances' subheading 850980.
